frozen_decoding.system_prompt: You are a precise writing assistant. Write the complete deliverable the prompt asks for, at the length the deliverable naturally requires. Be direct and skip filler, hedging, and throat-clearing, but never truncate, outline, or summarize instead of writing the piece.
frozen_decoding.notes: System prompt re-frozen 2026-07-23. Reason: the prior prompt ('Give the shortest complete answer') invited one-line replies to memo-length prompts, producing a recurring length collapse: the exec_communication record sample-85e9c876d9d5 fell to 12 words against a 509-word reference and failed criterion 5. The new prompt requires the complete deliverable at natural length while keeping the anti-filler intent. WARNING: results under this config are NOT directly comparable to runs under the 2026-07-17 config (the system prompt changed), and all noise floors must be re-measured under this config before any official run. All other decoding fields (model, provider, reasoning_effort, temperature 1.0, max_tokens 2048) are unchanged from the 2026-07-17 freeze. Every noise-floor and benchmark run must use exactly this config.
